# 1. Setup

```{r packages}
# Install once:
# if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
# BiocManager::install(c("Biostrings", "msa"))
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "ape", "phangorn", "randomForest", "rentrez"))

library(Biostrings)    # sequence handling
library(msa)           # multiple sequence alignment
library(ape)           # phylogenetics
library(phangorn)      # distances, bootstrap
library(tidyverse)     # data wrangling + ggplot2
library(randomForest)  # predictive model
```

# 2. Data import

Sequences were downloaded with `01_download_data.R` (NCBI GenBank, HA gene,
H3N2, 2014-2024).

```{r import}
fa <- readDNAStringSet("../data/h3n2_ha.fasta")
length(fa)

# Parse metadata from the FASTA headers, e.g.
# ">CY121680.1 Influenza A virus (A/Boston/DOA2107/2012(H3N2)) hemagglutinin (HA) gene, complete cds"
meta <- tibble(
  header    = names(fa),
  accession = str_extract(header, "^\\S+"),
  strain    = str_match(header, "\\((A/[^()]*)\\(H3N2\\)\\)")[, 2],
  year      = as.integer(str_match(header, "/(\\d{4})\\(H3N2\\)")[, 2]),
  length    = width(fa),
  gc        = as.numeric(letterFrequency(fa, "GC", as.prob = TRUE)),
  n_frac    = as.numeric(letterFrequency(fa, "N",  as.prob = TRUE))
)
glimpse(meta)
```

# 3. Quality control and cleaning

```{r qc}
cat("Raw sequences:", nrow(meta), "\n")
cat("Missing year:", sum(is.na(meta$year)), "\n")
cat("Duplicate accessions:", sum(duplicated(meta$accession)), "\n")

# Keep complete-length sequences with few ambiguous bases and a known year
keep <- !is.na(meta$year) & !duplicated(meta$accession) &
        meta$n_frac < 0.01 & meta$length >= 1650 & meta$length <= 2000
cat("Passing QC:", sum(keep), "\n")

fa   <- fa[keep]
meta <- meta[keep, ]
names(fa) <- meta$accession
```

```{r fig-counts}
p_counts <- ggplot(meta, aes(factor(year))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Sequences per year after QC", x = "Year", y = "Number of sequences")
p_counts
ggsave("../figures/fig1_counts_per_year.png", p_counts, width = 7, height = 4)
```

```{r fig-qc}
p_len <- ggplot(meta, aes(length)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "grey40") +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Sequence length", x = "Nucleotides", y = "Count")

p_gc <- ggplot(meta, aes(factor(year), gc * 100)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title = "GC content by year", x = "Year", y = "GC (%)")

p_len
p_gc
ggsave("../figures/fig2a_length.png", p_len, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave("../figures/fig2b_gc.png", p_gc, width = 7, height = 4)
```

# 4. Extract coding sequence and translate

HA starts at the first ATGAAG (Met-Lys). We translate from there and stop at
the first stop codon.

```{r translate}
txt   <- as.character(fa)
start <- as.integer(regexpr("ATGAAG", txt, fixed = TRUE))
ok    <- start > 0

cds  <- subseq(fa[ok], start = start[ok])
prot <- suppressWarnings(translate(cds, if.fuzzy.codons = "X"))
prot_chr <- sub("\\*.*$", "", as.character(prot))   # cut at first stop

# Keep proteins that start with M and have a plausible HA length (~566 aa)
good <- startsWith(prot_chr, "M") & nchar(prot_chr) >= 550 & nchar(prot_chr) <= 575
cat("Proteins retained:", sum(good), "\n")

meta <- meta[ok, ][good, ]
prot_set <- AAStringSet(prot_chr[good])
names(prot_set) <- meta$accession
```

# 5. Multiple sequence alignment

```{r align}
aln    <- msa(prot_set, method = "Muscle", type = "protein")
aa_aln <- as(aln, "AAStringSet")
mat    <- as.matrix(aa_aln)       # sequences x sites (character matrix)

# Make sure metadata and alignment rows are in the same order
meta <- meta[match(rownames(mat), meta$accession), ]
stopifnot(all(meta$accession == rownames(mat)))

dim(mat)
```

# 6. Divergence from a reference over time

The reference is the per-site consensus of the **earliest year** in the data.
To compare against an actual WHO vaccine strain instead, add that sequence to
the download and use it as the reference.

```{r divergence}
gap_or_x <- c("-", "X")

consensus_of <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!x %in% gap_or_x]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  names(which.max(table(x)))
}

ref_year  <- min(meta$year)
reference <- apply(mat[meta$year == ref_year, , drop = FALSE], 2, consensus_of)

# Number of amino acid substitutions of each sequence relative to the reference
meta$n_subs <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) {
  s  <- mat[i, ]
  ok <- !is.na(reference) & !s %in% gap_or_x
  sum(s[ok] != reference[ok])
}, numeric(1))

# Statistical tests: does divergence increase with time?
cor_res <- cor.test(meta$year, meta$n_subs, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
fit     <- lm(n_subs ~ year, data = meta)
cor_res
summary(fit)
confint(fit)["year", ]   # estimated substitutions gained per year
```

```{r fig-divergence}
p_div <- ggplot(meta, aes(year, n_subs)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, colour = "firebrick") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(meta$year))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste0("HA divergence from the ", ref_year, " consensus"),
       subtitle = paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(cor_res$estimate, 2),
                         ", p = ", signif(cor_res$p.value, 2)),
       x = "Year", y = "Amino acid substitutions")
p_div
ggsave("../figures/fig3_divergence.png", p_div, width = 7, height = 5)
```

# 7. Site-wise variability and antigenic sites

```{r entropy}
site_stats <- tibble(
  aln_pos = seq_len(ncol(mat)),
  entropy = apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    x <- x[!x %in% gap_or_x]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    p <- table(x) / length(x)
    -sum(p * log2(p))
  }),
  maf = apply(mat, 2, function(x) {       # minor allele frequency
    x <- x[!x %in% gap_or_x]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    1 - max(table(x)) / length(x)
  })
)

# H3 numbering excludes the 16-residue signal peptide
site_stats$h3_pos <- site_stats$aln_pos - 16

# Classical H3 antigenic sites A-E (Wiley et al. 1981; Wilson & Cox 1990).
# IMPORTANT: verify these position lists against the primary literature
# before submitting, and cite your source in the report.
antigenic <- list(
  A = c(122, 124, 126, 130:133, 135, 137, 138, 140, 142:146, 150, 152, 168),
  B = c(128, 129, 155:160, 163:165, 186:190, 192:194),
  C = c(44:48, 50, 51, 53, 54, 273, 275, 276, 278:280, 294, 297, 299, 300,
        304, 305, 307:312),
  D = c(96, 102, 103, 117, 121, 167, 170:177, 179, 182, 201, 203, 207:209,
        212:219, 226:230, 238, 240, 242, 244, 246:248),
  E = c(57, 59, 62, 63, 67, 75, 78, 80:83, 86:88, 91, 92, 94, 109,
        260:262, 265)
)
antigenic_all <- sort(unique(unlist(antigenic)))
site_stats$antigenic <- site_stats$h3_pos %in% antigenic_all

# Define "variable" sites as those with a minor allele frequency of >= 2%
site_stats$variable <- !is.na(site_stats$maf) & site_stats$maf >= 0.02
table(variable = site_stats$variable, antigenic = site_stats$antigenic)
```

```{r fig-entropy}
p_ent <- ggplot(site_stats, aes(h3_pos, entropy)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = h3_pos, yend = 0, colour = antigenic), linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "firebrick"),
                      labels = c("Other", "Antigenic site")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Per-site variability along HA",
       x = "Position (H3 numbering)", y = "Shannon entropy (bits)", colour = "")
p_ent
ggsave("../figures/fig4_entropy.png", p_ent, width = 8, height = 4)
```

```{r fisher}
# Are variable sites enriched in the antigenic sites?
# Caveat: sequences share ancestry, so p-values should be read cautiously.
tab <- table(variable = site_stats$variable, antigenic = site_stats$antigenic)
tab
fisher.test(tab)
```

# 8. Phylogeny

```{r tree}
phy  <- phyDat(mat, type = "AA")
tree <- NJ(dist.hamming(phy))
tree$edge.length <- pmax(tree$edge.length, 0)   # NJ can give tiny negatives

# Bootstrap support (100 replicates; increase for the final report)
bs <- bootstrap.phyDat(phy, FUN = function(x) NJ(dist.hamming(x)), bs = 100)
support <- prop.clades(tree, bs) / length(bs) * 100
summary(support)
```

```{r fig-tree, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
yrs  <- meta$year[match(tree$tip.label, meta$accession)]
pal  <- hcl.colors(length(unique(yrs)), "viridis")
cols <- pal[as.integer(factor(yrs))]

draw_tree <- function() {
  plot(tree, type = "unrooted", show.tip.label = FALSE, edge.width = 0.6,
       no.margin = TRUE)
  tiplabels(pch = 16, col = cols, cex = 0.6)
  legend("bottomleft", legend = levels(factor(yrs)), pt.bg = pal, pch = 21,
         title = "Year", cex = 0.7, bty = "n")
}
draw_tree()
png("../figures/fig5_tree.png", width = 1600, height = 1600, res = 200)
draw_tree()
dev.off()
```

# 9. Predictive model: can sequence predict the year?

A random forest regresses the sampling year on residues at variable sites.
Out-of-bag (OOB) error gives an honest internal estimate, and variable
importance highlights the sites that track time most strongly.

```{r rf}
var_pos <- site_stats$aln_pos[site_stats$variable]
X <- as.data.frame(mat[, var_pos, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
colnames(X) <- paste0("P", var_pos)   # P<alignment position>

rf <- randomForest(x = X, y = meta$year, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
rf   # % variance explained is the OOB estimate

oob_df <- tibble(actual = meta$year, predicted = rf$predicted)
p_rf <- ggplot(oob_df, aes(actual, predicted)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Random forest: out-of-bag predicted vs actual year",
       subtitle = paste0("% variance explained: ", round(tail(rf$rsq, 1) * 100, 1)),
       x = "Actual year", y = "Predicted year")
p_rf
ggsave("../figures/fig6_rf_oob.png", p_rf, width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r rf-importance}
imp <- importance(rf, type = 1) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("site") |>
  rename(inc_mse = `%IncMSE`) |>
  mutate(aln_pos = as.integer(sub("P", "", site)),
         h3_pos  = aln_pos - 16,
         antigenic = h3_pos %in% antigenic_all) |>
  arrange(desc(inc_mse))

top_sites <- head(imp, 15)
top_sites
write.csv(top_sites, "../results/top_rf_sites.csv", row.names = FALSE)

p_imp <- ggplot(top_sites, aes(reorder(factor(h3_pos), inc_mse), inc_mse, fill = antigenic)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey60", "firebrick")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 sites predicting year", x = "HA position (H3 numbering)",
       y = "% increase in MSE when permuted", fill = "Antigenic site")
p_imp
ggsave("../figures/fig7_rf_importance.png", p_imp, width = 6, height = 5)
```
